articles.title: Agents can trade 24/7 — but Yat Siu warns you could lose access at any time
articles.snippet: The Animoca Brands chairman explains that AI agents can make trades while you sleep, but users need to plan for the day they lose access to the bots.

articles.title: Drift exploiter sends $61M ETH to Tornado Cash, holds $194M
articles.snippet: The April 1 hack caused about $295 million in losses and was later attributed to a North Korean threat group in a Mandiant investigation.

articles.title: Wallet Linked to Drift Exploit Sends $61 Million in Ethereum to Tornado Cash
articles.snippet: The North Korea-linked attacker behind April's $295 million Drift heist pushed 25,700 ETH through the mixer in two hours, and still controls roughly $198 million more.
